description: This file defines classes and templates for handling parcelable data types in Android's binder IPC mechanism, including safe interface wrappers for remote and local binder calls, with extensive template metaprogramming for argument handling.

classes.name: ParcelHandler
classes.description: A utility class for reading and writing various data types to and from Parcel objects in a type-safe and generic manner.

classes.name: SafeBpInterface
classes.description: A template class providing safe remote binder interface calls with argument validation and error handling.

classes.name: SafeBnInterface
classes.description: A template class providing safe local binder interface handling with argument processing and error handling.

methods.name: callRemote
methods.description: Invokes a synchronous remote binder method with argument validation, parceling, and result extraction.

methods.name: callRemoteAsync
methods.description: Invokes an asynchronous remote binder method with argument validation and parceling.

methods.name: callLocal
methods.description: Handles local binder method calls with argument unpacking and result packing.

methods.name: callLocalAsync
methods.description: Handles local binder asynchronous method calls.
